retrieval.statement: Relative to the two reference fine-tunes, this run appears more prone to confident confabulation and format instability. On detector-selected prompts it often adds unsupported concrete details—exact sports scores/times, named officials or historical figures, local festivals, statistics, websites/social handles, tourism/current-event claims, and dubious low-resource-language interpretations—where references stay generic or hedge. It also more often mishandles local constraints: wrong capitalization, forbidden terms, malformed JSON/postscript placement, extra or missing highlight/title markers, overlong bullet counts, and occasional repetition/gibberish. In some coding/math continuations it omits required output or reconstruction steps, or continues with unsolicited new subproblems. A secondary pattern is slightly more prevention/help-seeking framing in harm/relationship-adjacent prompts. Overall this is not just seed-level wording variation; the model is distinctively more specific but less grounded and less reliably constraint-following.
